Name: Industrialization Redux - Blue Eggs and Golden Mayo Compatibility Patch
Author: witchtopia
Description:
[size=5]🧩 [b]DELUXE MAYO, NOW ACTUALLY DELUXE![/b] 💙[/size]

Using [b]Industrialization Redux[/b] together with [b](CP) Blue Eggs and Golden Mayo (Now with extra Ostrich)[/b]?

You may have noticed that the regular Mayonnaise Machine handles the special eggs just fine, while [b]Industrialization Redux’s MayoMaker Deluxe[/b] takes one look at them and decides they simply do not exist.

This tiny compatibility patch fixes that! ✨

[center]🧩━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━🧩[/center]

[size=4]✨ [b]MOD FEATURES[/b] ✨[/size]

🥚 [b]Blue Egg → Blue Mayo[/b]
The MayoMaker Deluxe can now process Blue Eggs into Blue Mayo.

🌟 [b]Golden Egg → Golden Mayo[/b]
Golden Eggs are now properly recognized and turned into Golden Mayo.

🪶 [b]Ostrich Egg → Ostrich Mayo[/b]
Ostrich Eggs can now be processed into Ostrich Mayo.

⭐ [b]Ostrich quality is preserved![/b]
Ostrich Mayo keeps the quality of the Ostrich Egg used to make it.

📦 [b]Works with Deluxe batch processing![/b]
The MayoMaker Deluxe can accept [b]1–5 matching eggs per batch[/b], with [b]Extra Machine Config[/b] scaling the mayonnaise output to match the number of eggs inserted.

⏰ [b]Matches Industrialization Redux’s existing timing![/b]
Each batch takes [b]180 in-game minutes[/b], just like the machine’s normal recipes.

🪶 [b]Patch only![/b]
No items, machines, textures, or assets from either original mod are included. This mod simply adds the missing Content Patcher machine rules.

[center]🧩━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━🧩[/center]

[size=4]⚙️ [b]HOW IT WORKS[/b] ⚙️[/size]

This patch extends [b]Industrialization Redux’s existing MayoMaker Deluxe[/b] rather than replacing or modifying the machine itself.

It adds new output rules that reference the eggs and mayonnaise already provided by [b]Blue Eggs and Golden Mayo[/b].

In other words:

Industrialization Redux provides the machine.
Blue Eggs and Golden Mayo provides the eggs and mayo.
This patch introduces them to each other. 💕🥚

[center]🧩━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━🧩[/center]

[size=4]📥 [b]HOW TO INSTALL[/b] 📥[/size]

You’ll need:

🌱 [b]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/b]

🔧 [b]SMAPI[/b]

🧩 [b]Content Patcher 2.0+[/b]

🏭 [b]Industrialization Redux 1.2.6+[/b]

🥚 [b](CP) Blue Eggs and Golden Mayo (Now with extra Ostrich) 1.1.2+[/b]

⚙️ [b]Extra Machine Config[/b]

Once those are installed, extract [b]Industrialization Redux - Blue Eggs and Golden Mayo Compatibility Patch[/b] into your Stardew Valley [b]Mods[/b] folder and launch the game through SMAPI.

Do [b]not[/b] place the patch inside the [b]Industrialization Redux[/b] or [b]Blue Eggs and Golden Mayo[/b] folders. It should remain its own separate mod.
[center]🧩━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━🧩[/center]

[size=4]🥚 [b]BLUE EGGS & GOLDEN MAYO SETTINGS[/b] 🥚[/size]

Make sure the corresponding mayonnaise options are enabled in [b]Blue Eggs and Golden Mayo[/b].

For full functionality, you’ll want:

💙 [b]Blue Mayo enabled[/b]

🌟 [b]Golden Mayo enabled[/b]

🪶 [b]Ostrich Mayo enabled[/b]

The patch references the items provided by that mod, so if one of those products is disabled, there won’t be a corresponding mayonnaise item for the Deluxe machine to produce.

[center]🧩━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━🧩[/center]

[size=4]🧩 [b]COMPATIBILITY NOTES[/b] 🧩[/size]

This patch only adds [b]output rules to Industrialization Redux’s MayoMaker Deluxe[/b].

It does [b]not[/b] replace either original mod and contains no textures, sprites, or other visual assets, so visual replacers for the affected eggs or mayonnaise should generally be unaffected.

It is specifically designed for:

🏭 [b]Industrialization Redux 1.2.6+[/b]

🥚 [b]Blue Eggs and Golden Mayo 1.1.2+[/b]

Future updates to either mod may require this patch to be updated if their internal machine or item IDs change.

[center]🧩━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━🧩[/center]

[size=4]💌 [b]A LITTLE CREDIT WHERE CREDIT'S DUE[/b] 💌[/size]

This is only a compatibility patch and does [b]not[/b] redistribute assets from either original mod. The only place their assets are used are in the promo image for this mod.

Please download the required mods from their original authors, and toss them an endorsement while you’re there. They did the actual heavy lifting. 💙✨
